Flow Traders is looking for a PhD Graduate Quantitative Researcher to join the quantitative trading team at our Hong Kong office. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm, working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. As a firm, we are committed to leveraging advances in computer science, statistics, and machine learning to generate value in the financial markets.

A successful Quantitative Researcher is an expert in mathematics and statistics, passionate about translating challenging quantitative problems into equations and models, and skilled at optimizing them using cutting-edge computational techniques. If you're at the top of your quantitative, modeling, and coding game, and excited to test these skills in competitive live markets, this opportunity is for you.

 

What you will do

  • Design, build, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art models and algorithms for systematic trading.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify patterns and signals that can be translated into trading strategies.
  • Collaborate with traders and technologists to bring models from research into live production.
  • Monitor and refine existing models based on live market performance.

 

What you need to succeed

  • A PhD degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field.

jobs.title: Risk Manager
jobs.description_text:
Flow Traders is looking for an experienced Risk Manager to join our Risk team in Hong Kong. The ideal candidate is communicative, decisive, and thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.

The Risk Manager will report into the regional Head of Risk and work alongside a small team responsible for Market & Credit Risk (MCR) and Treasury & Capital Management (TCM) across our APAC trading business. This is a hands-on role that combines quantitative risk analysis in close collaboration with Trading and Technology.

What You Will Do

  • Evaluate and monitor APAC trading positions against market and credit risk limits, across multiple asset classes including Digital Assets
  • Provide management with regular updates on P&L and risk exposure
  • Analyse trading strategies and perform quantitative and qualitative risk analysis
  • Support the Head of Risk in developing and enhancing the risk management framework, policies, and procedures for the region, working in coordination with global Risk teams
  • Develop, implement, and enhance risk models, quantitative analytics, reports, and processes, using automation and AI tools
  • Ensure other risk categories, including credit, operational, and regulatory risk, are managed within the business's risk appetite
  • Support daily Treasury, securities borrowing and lending (SBL), and capital management activities

What You Need to Succeed

jobs.description_text:
Flow Traders is seeking an experienced Senior Regulatory & Securities Attorney to serve as senior in-house legal advisor on U.S. securities law across its ETF, cash equity, digital-asset, and tokenization businesses.

This role will provide legal guidance to trading, business, and operations teams; supports  transactional and regulatory legal work; advise on regulatory developments and new business initiatives; and help manage legal risk in a complex, fast-paced, and internationally integrated new environment.

The candidate will work closely with Compliance, Risk, and Business Development, while operating as an integrated member of Flow Traders’ global Legal team. The role will have a  meaningful focus on digital assets, tokenization, market structure, and the application of securities laws to emerging financial products and infrastructure.

  • Advise business, trading, and operations teams on broker-dealer regulatory requirements, trading practices, and new product development.
  • Provide legal guidance on digital asset classification, tokenized securities, and application of securities frameworks to blockchain-based products.

jobs.title: Trading Intern
jobs.description_text:
Flow Traders is looking for entrepreneurial, competitive, and analytical students to join our Trading department as an Intern. What better way to find out if a career in Trading is something for you, than by experiencing it yourself as a Trading Intern!

You will get a 360-degree view of our role in the financial markets, how our Traders seize opportunities, and how they work together as a team to optimize and improve their trading desk. This Trading internship is about immersing yourself in the financial markets and experiencing trading up close. You do not need to have a financial background; we will teach you all you need to know.

Experience with a scientific programming language or excel is a definite advantage. Working closely with Traders and Quantitative Researchers, you will add value by working on real trading projects. You will solve problems, create new tools and/or design new strategies. You will test your project in a trading simulation.

What You Will Do

  • Learn directly from industry leaders on the APAC Trading floor
  • Participate in educational courses and trading simulations
  • Design trading strategies through project-based work using quantitative modelling and trading applications
  • Work through real life trading problems with our Traders and Quantitative Researchers
  • Gain insight into Flow Traders’ core business

jobs.description_text:
Why we started W3BWAVE

The impact of crypto on trading has been both profound and multifaceted and we expect it to reshape traditional financial markets with unprecedented speed. As this space evolves, we want to ensure that the next wave of talent looking to develop careers in trading or technology is properly equipped to understand this fast-changing world and its full potential, which is why Flow Traders, Deribit and Bitvavo have launched the Netherlands first dedicated Crypto talent pool - W3BWAVE.

Currently, there are no studies or associations in the Netherlands focused on digital assets or crypto. Therefore, as three leading firms in the space, we want to bring this cutting-edge financial development to the student population.

Are you interested in joining this unique Talent Pool? We are always searching for passionate individuals with an interest in crypto. If you are intrigued by or already involved in the digital asset space, we want to hear from you!

Discover our approach to digital assets, how we embrace talent development, and foster the next generation of crypto traders and developers.

jobs.description_text:
Apply early for priority consideration. Gallup has limited openings for this internship, and the position will be filled quickly.

As an AI/ML research intern at Gallup, you’ll investigate important technical questions at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning and behavioral science. Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you’ll design experiments, evaluate new models and methods, build prototypes, and help determine which emerging AI approaches are worth applying to Gallup’s products and AI systems.

You’ll work in a unique environment where Gallup’s behavioral science, proprietary data and decades of research meet rapidly advancing AI technology. Your work will influence real systems designed to help people and organizations make better decisions.

What You’ll Do

During your internship, you will:

  • Research advances in AI and machine learning, reproduce promising approaches and evaluate whether they meaningfully improve on existing methods
  • Design and contribute to experiments and prototypes that test new approaches to AI systems, applied machine learning and AI-enabled products
  • Investigate technical questions involving AI systems, retrieval and knowledge systems, model evaluation, machine learning, and other areas relevant to Gallup’s AI research
  • Turn research questions into hypotheses, experiments, measurable results and technical recommendations

jobs.description_text:
About General Atlantic

General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 885 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $126 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of March 31, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions. Ginkgo is constructing, editing, and redesigning the living world in order to answer the globe’s growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more. We are looking for an Automation Scientist Intern to be the hands-on force behind this fleet. You will learn how to load, operate, take down, and troubleshoot protocol runs on the most advanced lab automation hardware in the world, pushing our "Nebula" frontier lab towards autonomous operation.
